claim_boundary: This proves P3 and NOTHING above it. AIR lowers and executes elementwise programs including fused multi-op SSA chains and a specialization constant, graded against numpy. It does NOT prove P4 (no CUDA kernel has been translated), P5 (no comparison against a naive translation or against MLX/llama.cpp exists), or any performance claim whatsoever -- nothing here was timed. AIR does not yet represent synchronization, side effects, memory-domain requirements or multi-device placement constraints; only elementwise ops over one shape and one dtype are supported, so GEMM, attention and reductions from the steer's required corpus are absent.
